title: LibTractor domain separator uses wrong typehash (BLUEPRINT not EIP712Domain)
description: LibTractor._domainSeparatorV4() (line 173-184) computes the EIP-712 domain separator as keccak256(abi.encode(BLUEPRINT_TYPE_HASH, TRACTOR_HASHED_NAME, TRACTOR_HASHED_VERSION, C.getChainId(), address(this))). It uses BLUEPRINT_TYPE_HASH (the Blueprint struct typehash, line 28) as the domain typehash, while the correctly-defined EIP712_TYPE_HASH constant (the EIP712Domain typehash, line 24-27) is never referenced. This is a malformed domain separator: it does not match the EIP-712 standard digest that off-chain signers / wallets (eth_signTypedData) and verifying tools produce. Note this does NOT create a signature-replay or auth-bypass vulnerability: the same (non-standard) separator is used consistently on-chain by both the signer-recovery path and the verifier, chainId IS included via C.getChainId(), and TractorFacet uses a per-blueprintHash nonce incremented in runBlueprint with a maxNonce ceiling, so blueprint replay is bounded. The impact is interoperability/standards-correctness: signatures produced by a standards-compliant EIP-712 signer will not verify, and any tooling assuming a standard domain will fail. It does not advance to Medium under ICE because no privilege escalation or unauthorized state change results (consumer impact is signature non-verification, i.e. self-DoS of legitimate signers, already a likely usability issue rather than an attacker capability).
impact: Non-standard EIP-712 domain separator: signatures from standard tooling will not verify against Tractor blueprints. No auth bypass, no replay (chainId present, per-blueprint nonce enforced). Severity Low (standards/interoperability correctness).

ite.intent: (no attacker intent) - standards/correctness defect, not an exploit
ite.technique: Domain separator hashes the Blueprint struct typehash in place of the EIP712Domain typehash
ite.evasion: Dedicated EIP712_TYPE_HASH constant exists but is unused; the wrong constant is consistent on-chain so internal verification still self-validates

ice_chain.corrupted_state: Tractor EIP-712 domain separator / blueprint signing digest
ice_chain.impact: Standards-compliant off-chain signatures do not verify; no unauthorized capability is granted
ice_chain.exploit_path: No exploit path - legitimate standard signatures fail verification (self-DoS/usability), not attacker privilege gain
